host.dbus: DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS removed for every app measured

metrics.label: Cold start to first paint
metrics.plain: Time from double-click to the page being visible
metrics.method: exec -> first frame containing the page's own marker colour, polled from the framebuffer at ~4 ms; fresh profile and fresh X display server per run. Not screenshot-mode minus a baseline: that path carries a fixed 900 ms settle.

metrics.label: Memory, one tab open (PSS)
metrics.plain: Memory the app uses sitting idle with one tab
metrics.method: Sum of Pss over every process in the app's pid tree (/proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup), 30 s after the tab loaded. PSS splits a shared page between the processes mapping it, so it is the number that adds up to real memory. Summed RSS is the row below.
metrics.improved: reported as PSS, which does not double count shared pages

metrics.label: Memory, one tab open (summed RSS)
metrics.plain: The same app, counted the old way: every process's RSS added up
metrics.method: Sum of Rss over the same process tree. Every process maps the same libcef.so, so this counts those ~277 MB once per process: it is an upper bound, not memory in use. Kept because the original budget was written in these units.

metrics.label: Extra memory for a 2nd space
metrics.plain: Memory added by a second space inside the same profile
metrics.method: (PSS with 2 spaces - PSS with 1 space), same page in both, same profile, 30 s after load. The 0.3.0 figure was summed RSS over 4-vs-1 spaces, when every space also had its own browser context: that counted libcef once per renderer, which is why 130 MB was a real measurement of the wrong quantity.
metrics.improved: measured per space, not per renderer

metrics.label: Extra memory for the 4th space
metrics.plain: Memory added by the third and fourth space, per space
metrics.method: ((PSS with 4 spaces - PSS with 2 spaces) / 2), same page in every space, same profile, 30 s after load.
metrics.improved: measured per space, not per renderer

metrics.label: Extra memory for a 2nd profile
metrics.plain: Memory added by a second profile, which is a whole separate browser context
metrics.method: (PSS with 1 space + 1 space in a second profile - PSS with 1 space), same page, 30 s after load; the second profile's space is created over the control socket with createProfile + createSpace(profileId), the same calls the bridge makes.
metrics.improved: new measurement: profiles are the isolation boundary now

metrics.label: CPU while idle
metrics.plain: Share of one processor core wasted while nothing is happening
metrics.method: Delta of utime+stime over the whole process tree across a 60 s window, 4 spaces (3 parked, the visible one included), divided by the window: percent of one core. Kernel jiffies, so ±0.02 %.

metrics.label: Snapshot p50, viewport
metrics.plain: Time for an agent to read the page it is looking at
metrics.method: 30 viewport snapshots per run x 3 runs on the long list (2412 elements), through 'ego-browser nodejs' with ROOK_BACKEND=host (bridge -> control socket -> CEF). The snapshot's own scope header says what was returned; each run's p50, then median and spread across runs.

metrics.label: Snapshot p95, viewport
metrics.plain: Time for an agent to read a heavy dashboard, slow case
metrics.method: Same samples as the p50 row; p95 of each run on the heavy dashboard (3797 elements), median and spread across runs.

detail.header: snapshot scope=viewport only, 133 lines, 604 refs, 3245 nodes outside the viewport not shown - pass {scope:"full_page"} for the whole page

metrics.label: Snapshot p50, full page
metrics.plain: The same read, with nothing filtered out
metrics.method: Same CLI round, 20 'full_page' snapshots per run on the long list. Not part of the original budget, which is written for the default viewport scope.

metrics.label: Snapshot p95, full page
metrics.plain: The slow case of the same read, with nothing filtered out
metrics.method: Same samples as the full-page p50 row; p95 on the heavy dashboard (3797 elements).

metrics.label: Agent round (navigate → snapshot → click → type)
metrics.plain: How long one complete agent step takes, from the command line
metrics.method: One 'ego-browser nodejs' invocation per run, 3 runs, on the local small-form page: create space, open the page, snapshot, click "Forgot password?", click the email field, type 15 characters, finish. Timed from spawn to exit; the script stamps every phase on the same clock.

metrics.label: Installed size
metrics.plain: Disk space the package takes after installing
metrics.method: dpkg's Installed-Size field of the .deb (KiB -> MB), i.e. what dpkg reports for the installed tree. The compressed .deb and the AppImage are listed for context.

baselines.label: Chrome, headless, one tab
baselines.plain: Plain Chrome with one page open, for comparison
baselines.method: google-chrome --headless=new, one page loaded, PSS over the Chrome pid tree after a 15 s window.

baselines.label: Chrome, headless, cold start
baselines.plain: Time for plain Chrome to produce a rendered frame
baselines.method: exec -> PNG written by --screenshot, warm profile after a discarded warm-up. Headless Chrome has no window, so there is no framebuffer to poll; this is its own equivalent measurement, not the same instrument as the app's number.
